Thanks for the ping. Short answers:

- For NebulaSuite we should set them up as a cloud-catalog (marketplace) listing. That gives the best UX for buyers across AWS/Azure/GCP.
- Marketplace purchases can route two ways depending on the marketplace:
  * AWS/Azure: buyer pays marketplace (customer gets invoice from marketplace), Redwood records revenue via marketplace settlement. We still need vendor invoicing for our share where relevant.
  * GCP/Direct: some customers purchase via a direct PO to Redwood — in that case we need a PO number on the invoice and PO matching in Finance.
- Required vendor deliverables: signed seller onboarding form, W-9 (or equivalent tax form), banking information for payouts (we hold this behind KMS), and proof of liability insurance if applicable.

Ben, for PO evidence: please confirm the specific PO fields we need (PO number, billing entity name, billing address, marketplace order id). Also add whether we accept emailed POs or require them uploaded in the marketplace portal.

Suggested next steps to give the vendor:
1) Send them our Redwood seller intake packet (I can attach the canonical intake PDF).
2) Ask them to complete and return with W-9 and banking details.
3) Once received, finance will provision vendor ID and share the vendor code; marketplace listing team will schedule a 3-business-day activation window.

I'll attach the intake packet and the internal PO mapping guide.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Fwd: Cloud catalog vendor activation & purchase-flow for NebulaSuite

Olga/Vanessa —

We require the following on any direct PO that Redwood will process: PO number, billing entity (exact legal name as on vendor W-9), billing address, contact email for AP, and the marketplace order id when applicable. For marketplace-settled purchases we still require a reconciliation file from the marketplace (monthly) and a vendor statement for any payouts.

We can accept emailed POs but prefer they be uploaded to the marketplace portal (for automated matching). If a customer sends a direct PO to vendor, we need a copy forwarded to ap@redwood.ai with the PO number in the subject line for manual matching.

Timeline note: once we receive completed seller form + W-9 + banking details, Finance needs 48-72 hours to create vendor profile and payout credentials. Marketplace listing team will then schedule a publish slot (3 business days typical).

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia — great to connect. Per internal ops the onboarding checklist is below; if you can return the highlighted items we can provision NebulaSuite in our catalog and target a July 30 publish date:

Required (please return as PDFs):
- Completed Redwood seller onboarding form (I've attached our version)
- W-9 (completed and signed)
- Vendor banking details for payouts (bank routing + account name)
- Awarded PO or sample PO template (if you expect customers to use direct PO flow)

Optional but recommended:
- Certificate of liability insurance (if you have one)
- Point-of-contact for post-launch support and marketing co-op contact

Notes on PO flow:
- If customers buy via AWS/Azure marketplace, settlement happens through the marketplace; Redwood will reconcile monthly and remit any due amounts to NebulaSuite.
- If a customer sends a direct PO to Redwood, have them include the PO number and ensure it is forwarded to ap@redwood.ai for matching. Redwood requires PO number + billing entity name for invoicing.

I've attached: Redwood_Seller_Intake_Packet.pdf and our PO mapping guide. Once you upload the signed packet and W-9 to the DocuSign link below we will start vendor provisioning.
